notes.title: Massage Salon Story: Spring Breeze Now With English Support
notes.content:
Hey Players,

Thanks for playing our game! We're now glad to annouce that, our game is now fully translated in English, and you could now start using English to explore and have a good time with your customers!

We wish you have a great time playing our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39944570/b09453e14acb6af5f2c354468e77c9494e36541e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39944570/09176d4061614f8315ac22d8a6ab3af19a6755ce.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is Massage Salon?[/h2]

Many years after graduation, you back to your hometown and start running a massage salon.

In this town, Customers are waiting for you here. Satisfied your customers with different massage techniques and positions to satisfy their desires. Of course, it's a work to earn money!

Enjoy your life with Massage Salon!
